name: Aki no Koi.
source:
Main character is a student who is requested to inspect different school clubs. Depending on his choice he will end up with one of the persons there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名学生，被要求调查不同的学校社团。他会根据选择与其中一人走到一起。
